title: The human side of digital: Empowering construction workers through smart technology
summary: This blog explores how digital transformation is a human challenge, not just a technical one. By adopting intuitive, connected tools that reduce site friction and improve collaboration, UK firms can boost worker morale, simplify daily workflows and attract the next generation of talent.
